attributes.name: Sensuret the Tribe-Eater
attributes.powers:
Sensuret the Tribe-Eater is immune to the Mental and Poison traits.

If the check to defeat has the Cold trait, add 1d8.

After you act, bury 2 cards.

"The Shory liked to train dinosaurs to serve them. Sometimes, they liked those dinosaurs too much." –Chronicle of the Tribe-Eater
